Assistant._comment: REQUIRED — the API will NOT START until you fill this in, and there is no default on purpose. It selects which third-party AI provider receives assistant conversation data, and that is a choice about where personal data travels, so it is never made by omission. Admitted values: "OpenRouter" or "Groq" (both US-based; see docs/Legal.md §5 before changing it).

Groq._comment: The assistant's chat model. Leave ApiKey EMPTY here and put the real value in User Secrets: dotnet user-secrets set "Groq:ApiKey" "<your key>" (see README). With no key the assistant still works, answering with its stand-in reply.

UserManual._comment: Nothing to set in development: the build links docs/Wasnie_User_Manual.pdf into the output where the API looks. Replace that file to update the manual. Set FilePath only to override with an absolute path.
